HEATHEN-ONLY EVENTS (HE-01 to HE-45, draft for the owner, 2026-11-23, target v1.35.98)
New Believers only. Island events about the Heathens' own lives: honoring their dead, Heathen versions of events our villagers already have, and small moments of camp life.

collection.description: The Heathen children have been mixing powders behind the camp again, and there have been bangs.

description_variants.description: The Isolan children have been mixing powders behind the camp again, and there have been bangs.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) and the other Heathen children have been mixing powders behind the camp again. There have been several bangs this morning. One of them was quite big. (friend) goes to find out what is going on.

variants.text: (subject) and the other Isolan children have been mixing powders behind the camp again. There have been several bangs this morning. One of them was quite big. (friend) goes to find out what is going on.

choices.label: Teach Them to Do It Safely
Let Them Learn the Hard Way

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (friend) sits down with them and shows them how to measure, how to stand back, and how to keep the powders apart. There are still bangs after that, but smaller ones, and fewer eyebrows lost.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) decides they'll work it out. There is one more bang, quite a big one. Everyone is fine. (subject) has very short eyebrows for a while, and a new respect for measuring.
